title: Lemon Chicken Orzo Soup
seoTitle: Lemon Chicken Orzo Soup | Firefighter Meal
shortDescription: Bright broth with shredded chicken, orzo, and tender carrots
subtitle: Bright broth with shredded chicken, orzo, and tender carrots
description: Shredded chicken simmers in lemony broth with orzo, carrots, and dill until the soup is bright, silky, and filling.

steps.title: Poach chicken
steps.instruction: Simmer chicken breasts in 6 cups broth with bay leaves 15–18 minutes until 165°F. Rest, shred into bite-size strands with two forks.

steps.title: Cook orzo separately
steps.instruction: Boil orzo in salted water 8–9 minutes until al dente. Drain, toss with 1 tsp oil to prevent clumping.

steps.title: Build soup base
steps.instruction: Sauté onion, carrot, celery, and garlic in pot 6 minutes until softened. Add remaining broth and shredded chicken, simmer 10 minutes.

steps.title: Finish with lemon
steps.instruction: Remove from heat. Stir lemon juice, zest, and dill. Broth should taste bright and balanced, not harsh or overly tart.

steps.title: Serve with orzo
steps.instruction: Add cooked orzo to bowls, ladle soup over top. Orzo should stay separate, not swollen and mushy in the pot.

proTips: Never boil after adding lemon—it dulls the bright flavor.
Rotisserie chicken works in a pinch—add at the end.
Extra dill at the line makes the soup smell incredible.
leftovers: Store orzo separate from soup or it absorbs all broth overnight.
Freeze soup base without orzo for easy reheat.
whyCrewsLikeIt: Avgolemono vibes without the egg tempering fuss. Gentle on the stomach after a rough shift.
mealPrepNotes: Cook orzo separately and add at service to prevent bloating in the pot. Station: Poach chicken in broth for maximum flavor—do not use plain water. Station: Stir lemon juice off heat so broth stays bright, not curdled-looking. Station: Keep orzo in a separate hotel pan and add per bowl for best texture.
